# Jaipur Properties Hub / Eigentum Spaces
> Official Verified Real Estate & Property Portal in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India.

Jaipur Properties Hub (operated by Eigentum Spaces) is a specialized real estate portal for verified residential, luxury villas, builder floors, commercial office spaces, and JDA-approved residential plots across Jaipur.

## Primary Real Estate Sections

- [Properties for Sale](https://www.eigentumspaces.com/buy): Verified 1 BHK, 2 BHK, 3 BHK, 4 BHK apartments, luxury independent villas, and penthouses for sale in Jaipur.
- [Properties for Rent](https://www.eigentumspaces.com/rent): Verified rental flats, furnished homes, independent houses, and builder floors across Jaipur.
- [Commercial Properties](https://www.eigentumspaces.com/commercial): Prime commercial offices, showrooms, retail shops, and corporate spaces on Tonk Road, Vaishali Nagar, and Malviya Nagar.
- [New Projects](https://www.eigentumspaces.com/new-projects): RERA and JDA approved upcoming builder projects and gated communities in Jaipur.
- [Property Valuation & EMI Calculator](https://www.eigentumspaces.com/valuation): Real-time per sq.ft rate estimation, rental yield analysis, stamp duty calculation, and home loan EMI estimator.
- [Post Property](https://www.eigentumspaces.com/post-property): Verified property listing submission for owners, builders, and verified agents.

## Prime Localities in Jaipur
- **Vaishali Nagar**: Premium residential hubs, luxury 3/4 BHK apartments, and commercial high-streets.
- **Malviya Nagar**: High-demand residential villas near World Trade Park and Gaurav Tower.
- **Jagatpura & Mahal Road**: Modern high-rise apartment complexes, educational hubs, and airport connectivity.
- **Mansarovar & Mansarovar Extension**: High-demand residential colonies and budget apartments.
- **C-Scheme & Civil Lines**: Ultra-luxury heritage, bungalows, and premium high-end apartments.
- **Ajmer Road & Tonk Road**: Fast-growing investment corridors, SEZ zones, and township plots.

## Key Trust Features
- 100% Admin & Physically Verified Listings
- Direct Owner / Builder Contact with Zero Brokerage Options
- Instant WhatsApp & Call Connect
- Accurate Carpet Area & Pricing Transparency
